phase: 11 -- the official destination-marketing rosters (Visit Salt Lake, Visit Park City), measured first
the_bureau_was_measured: Every bureau was probed before it was read; the platform each one runs is recorded, never assumed.
the_category_filter_is_read_not_trusted: Only lodging-typed partners are kept; the census decides what each row is and where it is.
a_roster_row_is_not_a_policy: No bureau amenity chip or 'pet-friendly hotels' page is read, stored or published.
the_bureau_does_not_decide_membership: The row's own postal code does -- and decides its municipality.
